title: Make adapter upgrade path real: contracts run, sandbox unbypassable (VC-201-089)
goal: VC-201-089 refuted: contract checks are a caller-supplied bool (nothing runs); install_active installs any revision directly as live, bypassing stage+check+rollback entirely; a downgrade switches in as an upgrade (version never consulted); switching with nothing staged is indistinguishable from contract failure; and AdapterUpgrade has no production caller. Evidence: crates/susi-core/src/tests/vc_201_089_mastery.rs.
